body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

QA run record for the owed list: every checklist item whose QA-extracted fix card closed after the item's last verdict, as `node scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs` computed it on 2026-11-08 (73 rows), re-judged at one subject. Run by the QA seat `qa#1` (seat post #31433) under `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`; the round started on the maintainer's word after a development wave (no weekly cadence, ruling quoted on #31433; charter change #31434). The selector keeps the title grammar's spelling `owed:weekly`.

**Result: 73/73 judged · 61 PASS / 7 PARTIAL / 4 FAIL / 1 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN.** No item is `planned`. Of the 4 FAIL items, 2 are stale spec only (no product defect) and 2 are product defects. Off-clause probes found 6 more product defects. No security finding. Of the fix cards the owed rows name, every one the runners reached HOLDS; one holds only in part (#29882, defect D1 below).

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `objectstack-ai/objectstack` @ `0647dabb06ee314981b25fcc5a15de304de42c9d` (main HEAD at round open), detached in every runner. `ui/` is the in-tree import at the same commit; the Console was built from it (`pnpm console:build`).
- Execution: four cloud runner sessions, one agent each, each its own container, cold tree: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (119/119 tasks, 10–14 min), `pnpm console:build` for the browser slices. Each boot on its own port and file DB (`objectstack dev --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:...`), the stock showcase seed, personas minted by invite + sign-up or admin create-user, identity proved server-side before their cells. Playwright Chromium preinstalled.
- Slices and sessions:
  - C1 · api / build / cli · 23 items · `session_01QsR2jUHTQSxcZx6KJMvobE` · 07:57–08:37Z (setup ~12 min, testing ~28 min); ports 41711–41721.
  - C2 · studio-authoring · 17 items · `session_01QsR2jSdwQ3NQ5UzxZFCm36` · 07:57–09:15Z (setup ~16, testing ~62); ports 41001–41005, 4010, 5190.
  - C3a · access-security, approvals, automation, cli, identity-auth, integration-system · 17 items · `session_01QsR2jTgmLxBTVnAChM9vdf` · 08:44–09:53Z (setup ~15, testing ~54); ports 41310–41340; fixtures added: an SMTP sink (plugin-email `fake-smtp.testkit.ts`), PostgreSQL 16 on 54329, a local verdaccio with the 109 workspace packages packed from this sha.
  - C3b · dashboards, i18n, platform-core, records-forms, search, ux-conventions · 16 items · `session_01QsR2jRfDGkAPkptQJm7wXL` · 09:19–10:47Z (setup ~11, testing ~77); ports 41210, 41230, 5180. Declared deviation: its showcase items ran sequentially on one boot, each cleaning up after itself; one cross-item interaction (a pair package flipping Studio Publish out of the read-only posture) was found and undone before the affected variant was scored.
- Hygiene: every runner reports `git status` clean at the end and no `.objectstack/installed-packages` leak. C2 left one untracked scratch copy `examples/qa-picklist-copy/` in its own container (the repo's command hook refuses `rm -rf` inside the checkout); nothing was committed or pushed.
- Totals: environment ~54 runner-minutes, testing ~221 runner-minutes (about 1 : 4). Spend: no runner session exposes `usage.cost_usd`.

## Repro rules (every FAIL)

**R-1 · `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix` · acceptance[5] · STALE SPEC.** Read `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts:207`: `mode: SeedMode.default('ignore')`, describe "`ignore` (default) is create-only"; `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts:1303` `const mode = dataset.mode || config.defaultMode;`. Expected (clause): the default is `'upsert'`. Actual: `'ignore'`, changed by PR #30152 (merged 2026-11-04). The five members and the one-line seam hold. Re-point owed for steps[0], acceptance[0] and acceptance[5].

**R-2 · `platform-core.url-overlay-contract` · acceptance[1] tab half, acceptance[2], negative[0] tab half · STALE SPEC.** (1) Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_account/record/ID` and click Overview → Activity → Contacts → Field Zoo · Lookup → Account: the URL moves `?related=timeline` → `?related=showcase_contact.account` → `?related=showcase_field_zoo.f_lookup`, `history.length` grows by 1, and one Back returns to the bare record (Overview). (2) Cold load `…?tab=related`, `?tab=related:showcase_contact` and `?tab=activity`: Overview is selected; cold `…?related=showcase_contact.account`: the Contacts tab is selected. Source: `RecordDetailView.tsx:844-878` (leaving Overview pushes once, moving between tabs replaces). The URL-addressable tab capability holds under `?related=`; the clause names the retired `?tab=` and "one Back leaves the page". Palette and shortcuts (replace, 0 entries) hold.

**R-3 · `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` · acceptance[0], [1], [2] · PRODUCT DEFECT** (new control; no owed fix card). (1) Stock showcase, admin. (2) `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task` → Import. (3) Upload a CSV whose columns match no field, e.g. `foo,bar` / `x,1` / `y,2`. (4) Mapping step: both columns Skip. (5) `[data-testid=import-template-save-btn]` ("Save current", in `[data-testid=import-template-bar]`). Expected: the disabled control shows its reason on hover and is keyboard-reachable with an accessible description. Actual: native `disabled`, no `[role=tooltip]` after a 1.5 s hover, no `aria-describedby`, no `title`, no focusable wrapper; Tab skips it. Reproduced on 2 fresh loads. The sibling Next button on the same step passes (focusable wrapper + described reason). Eight other variants pass (Archive, read-only package ×3 surfaces, locked item #29897, unmapped fields, select-a-row).

**R-4 · `ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names` · acceptance[0] error-banner row · PRODUCT DEFECT.** (1) Showcase; mint a contributor-bound member and assign a task to it (`PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID {"assignee": MEMBER_EMAIL}`); the member switches the language to 中文. (2) As the member open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/calendar`. (3) As admin reassign the task away (`PATCH … {"assignee":"ada@example.com"}`). (4) As the member drag that card to another day. Expected: a translated message naming the object by its label (任务 / Task), no raw id. Actual: the PATCH answers 404, the card rolls back correctly, and the toast reads `Record WB5z1sLAsWgE1tXL not found in showcase_task` (English on a zh-CN session, machine object name, raw record id). Reproduced twice.

## Defect candidates found this round (extraction in the close-out comment)

- D1 · cli/runtime: the `os start --home H` (or `-d URL`) organization-ownership refusal prints ceremony commands with no database location (off-clause, beside `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`; re-judges #29882).
- D2 · rest: `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts` silently ignores `?package=` (off-clause, beside `studio-authoring.meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows`).
- D3 · service-automation: a screen-flow resume with a non-string value for a `text` field passes the resume gate and consumes the run (off-clause, beside `automation.screen-flow-roundtrip`).
- D4 · ui auth: with email+password off and phone sign-in on (no SSO), the login card collapses into the SSO-only view and offers "Back to single sign-on" (off-clause, beside `identity-auth.auth-method-matrix`; neighbour of #29159).
- D5 · ui plugin-grid: the import wizard's "Save current" template button is disabled with no reason (R-3).
- D6 · ui plugin-calendar: a failed reschedule toasts the raw server sentence (R-4).
- D7 · ui app-shell: Studio's disabled Publish ("No drafts pending publish") is unreachable by keyboard and shows no hover reason (off-clause, beside `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason`).
- D8 · rest: `POST /api/v1/email/send` with a JSON array body answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, not INVALID_REQUEST (off-clause, beside `integration-system.email-template-render` acceptance[7]; `packages/rest/src/email-routes.ts:268` tests `typeof body !== 'object'` and so admits an array).
